ido.question: A library lends out books. Input a pupil name and their current loan count, increase the count by one, then display both values.

steps.title: Input the name
steps.explanation: A variable can store a string from input().

steps.title: Store an integer
steps.explanation: Convert input text to an integer for counting.

steps.title: Update the same variable
steps.explanation: The assignment replaces the old loans value with loans + 1.
steps.code:
pupil = input("Pupil?")
loans = int(input("Current loans?"))
loans = loans + 1

steps.title: Display both values
steps.explanation: Sequence matters: display the updated number, not the old value.
steps.code:
pupil = input("Pupil?")
loans = int(input("Current loans?"))
loans = loans + 1
print(pupil)
print(loans)
